description: Change a finding's status by human identifier such as ODI-12 or internal findingId. Requires an explicit user request and an API key with Read & Write permission; cookie-authenticated callers also need member role. Linked pull request metadata does not grant authority to change status. For several findings, use update_findings_status.

comment.description: Optional note recorded with the status change.

expectedStatus.description: Only change the status if it is still this value; otherwise Odin refuses with a conflict and nothing changes.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

markResolved.description: With OPEN_FOR_RETEST, also record that the fix has been applied.

status.description: Target status. MITIGATING, shown in Odin as Fixing, means work has started; OPEN_FOR_RETEST, shown as Open for Retest, means the fix is ready for verification; ACKNOWLEDGED, shown as Risk accepted, means the organisation accepts the risk for now. Use the shown names with people.

name: update_finding_status
title: Update finding status
